notes.title: 【Friendly Adjustment】Notice on Optimizing Ration Acquisition per Round
notes.content:
Dear players,
Hope you're having a great time with the game! We've made a small, thoughtful adjustment based on everyone's experience.
To make collecting rations feel a bit more rewarding during each round, we've updated the ration acquisition to +9 per round. It's a little tweak, but we hope it makes your in-game journey smoother and brings a touch more joy to your collection efforts.
Thanks as always for your support and understanding—feel free to share any thoughts you have! Happy gaming, and may your adventures be fruitful!

notes.title: Chosen War Demo Launch Announcement
notes.content:
Dear Steam players, great news is coming! The demo of the strategic roguelike game "Chosen War" is about to be launched on Steam!
In "Chosen War", you will become the chosen one with a mission and embark on a thrilling adventure. The core of the game lies in forming a unique army roster and deploying troops. You need to flexibly match different types of troops and skillfully arrange formations according to different battle scenarios to gain victory on the battlefield. During the exploration of various mysterious islands, you not only have to utilize the powerful skills of the chosen one but also conduct precise operations on your army to engage in fierce battles with the enemy.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45381678/5b883cf16a3b43a05cd8b3d37239461a987a5707.jpg[/img]
Every time you successfully pass an island, you can receive generous rewards. These rewards may include the enhancement of troop strength, the liberation of imprisoned slaves and incorporating them into your army to expand your power, and even the chance to discover the astonishing treasures hidden by the Italian gods. And all these adventures will lead to the final showdown with the evil high priest. Only by defeating him can you achieve the ultimate victory and become a true legend.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45381678/522fbf5a493c9d75b55c49d48399cf039ce8cc29.png[/img]
The demo launched this time will fully present the core gameplay and exciting exploration content of the game, allowing you to experience the unique charm of "The Divine Selection War" in advance. Whether it's the intense and exciting battles or the exploration full of surprises, you will be deeply immersed in it. Please pay close attention to the Steam platform for the specific launch time. Are you ready to embark on this wonderful adventure? Let's write our own glorious chapters in the world of "Chonse War"!
